description: A climber's personal logbook tick recording an ascent or attempt on a route

subject.description: The OpenStreetMap climbing route, pitch, or boulder being ticked

style.description: Style of ascent: strictly onsight, flash, redpoint, or attempt

ascentInfo.description: Additional climbing style qualifiers (clean, toprope, lead, solo, second, aid, pinkpoint, hangdog)

grade.description: The climber's own grade opinion for the ascent, which may differ from the grade tagged in OpenStreetMap

comment.description: Personal comment or notes on the ascent

climbedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the climb occurred

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this tick record was created

ascentStyle.description: Ascent style for a climbing tick (strictly onsight, flash, redpoint, or attempt)

gradeRef.description: A grade in a given grading scale

value.description: Grade in that scale, e.g. '6a+' (French) or '5.10b' (YDS)
